notes.title: SuperEpic: new languages available!
notes.notes:
We're excited to bring you a new [b]SuperEpic Update[/b]! 

This time we're adding [b]Japanese[/b] and [b]Simplified Chinese[/b] to the available languages, so people for all over the globe can enjoy TanTan and Ola's adventure! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36138217/ff9bf828aa6882b72ecdadb119f58f896d37d98f.png[/img]


Due to popular petition, we've also uploaded the soundtrack to BandCamp, so everyone can get a chance to listen to it: [url=https://undercoders.bandcamp.com/releases]https://undercoders.bandcamp.com/releases[/url]

To celebrate the update, we're also conducting a special offer. Stay safe everyone and thank you for supporting SuperEpic!

notes.title: SuperEpic new Map Update!
notes.notes:
[h3]A new SuperEpic update is out now![/h3]

After a month of its original release and with all the great user feedback received, we're happy to announce that [b]SuperEpic's first update[/b] is now available on Steam and it's coming soon to other platforms!

This update's main focus was to[b] improve the in-game map's usability[/b] and include the much requested "reminder" option. With this feature players can add or remove a marker in the current room they're visiting, so they will remember there's something special to come back for later.

Here's an example of how this works:

[previewyoutube=nA8X0siAsAw;full][/previewyoutube]

This feature will work [b]both on Story and Roguelite mode[/b]!

But that's not the only map-related improvement. We've also added new elevator icons, which now show the associated floor number, and a few other important markers, such as the HR lady!

A few other minor issues were fixed for a better overall experience. Thanks to all the reviewers and players for their valuable feedback! We hope you enjoy the new SuperEpic features!

Best wishes, 
The Undercoders and Numskull Games team

notes.title: SuperEpic is here!
notes.notes:
SuperEpic is out now on all platforms!

A big thank you to everyone who has been keen to review the game in the run up to launch, both curators and media outlets. Releasing the game is always the most exciting part of game development so it was awesome to have a great reception from top review sites. Here's some of our favourites:

‘One of 2019’s best indie games’ –[url=https://culturedvultures.com/superepic-the-entertainment-war-switch-review/] Cultured Vultures[/url], [b]8.5/10[/b]

‘While it makes a point of poking fun at the state of the games industry, SuperEpic is also a lot of fun to play.’ – [url=http://www.nintendolife.com/reviews/switch-eshop/superepic_the_entertainment_war]Nintendo Life[/url], [b]8/10[/b]

‘Can’t recommend it enough.’ – [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UhKNVzncqGc]Grumpy Retro Gamers[/url]

‘SuperEpic is one of the biggest surprises that 2019 has given us.’  [url=https://as.com/meristation/2019/12/12/analisis/1576116435_687616.html]Meristation[/url], [b]8.5/10[/b]

We hope everyone here on Steam has a fabulous time playing SuperEpic and we wish you all the happiest of holidays! If you enjoy your time in the game, please leave us a review =)

Best wishes, 
The Undercoders and Numskull Games team

notes.title: SuperEpic is coming to Steam on 12th December 2019
notes.notes:
The daresome duo, Tan Tan the Raccoon and Ola the Llama, will be embarking on their noble quest to overthrow a pig-lead publisher on 12th December on Steam and other platforms. Join our heroes on this chuckle-filled Metroidvania adventure and put an end to the microtransaction-trends of future videogames.

You’ll be climbing the high-rise headquarters of RegnantCorp, a dystopian corporation brainwashing and extorting their customers. Dismantle the business and expose the full extent of their spying, lying and exploitation. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36138217/801f944c738fd91712e22b2f79ca07fbc222bff6.png[/img]

SuperEpic is super-packed full of classic adventure-RPG goodness; just take a look at the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1163560/]store page[/url]! 

We’ve been working on this project for 3 years now and in less than 30 days time it will be available for everyone! The team here at Undercoders have had such a fantastic time working on this game and we hope you enjoy it as much as we did making it.
 
-Undercoders
